overview: bali’s FRM-like/1 source forms x = 1 / pixel, sets z = x, and sets cclassic = fn1(z). Each loop forms the product (x + cclassic) * (x - cclassic) for z, then replaces x with fn2(z). The bailout is |z| <= 3.
